button.title: Vigil {version} is ready. Click to see what's new and install it
button.availableTitle: Vigil {version} is available. Click to see what's new

menu.dismiss: Don't remind me about this version

dialog.earlier: Notes for earlier versions are on GitHub.
dialog.empty: No release notes to show here; see the releases on GitHub.
dialog.language: Release notes are written in Chinese.
dialog.hint: Installing requires administrator permission. Vigil closes briefly and reopens on the same page when the installation finishes.
dialog.portable: The portable version doesn't update automatically. Download the new version from the release page.

service.title: Update the privileged service?
service.body: The privileged service is version {serviceVersion}, which doesn't match Vigil {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.bodyOlder: The privileged service is an older version that isn't compatible with Vigil {version}. Until it's updated, actions that need administrator rights (ending processes of administrators or other accounts, managing system services, closing network connections and so on) can't be completed, and data the service provides, such as per-process network traffic, isn't shown. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.restoresTaskManager: Updating first restores Windows Task Manager; the replacement can be turned on again in Settings afterwards.
service.done: The privileged service has been updated.
service.doneRestored: The privileged service has been updated and Windows Task Manager restored; the replacement can be turned on again in Settings.
